newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala's Menchu will not mediate in Peru crisis.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala's Menchu will not mediate in Peru crisis.

text.p: Nobel Peace Prize winner Rigoberta Menchu said on Thursday she did not plan to act as a mediator in the hostage crisis in Peru.

The Indian leader and human rights activist was responding to reports the Peruvian Congress would invite her to serve as a mediator between the government and Marxist rebels who are holding more than 100 diplomats and businessmen hostage in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.

"I don't think it's possible because we are in the preparations for the peace signing here," Menchu told reporters. On Dec. 29 the Guatemalan government and leftist rebels are to sign a definitive peace treaty ending 36 years of civil war.
Menchu said she believed it was important for the Peruvian government to respond seriously to the demands of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Army by entering into a dialogue.
